actionBar.unsavedDescription: Changes are kept while you browse Settings.

schedule_enabled.title: Scheduled backups
schedule_enabled.description: Create full backups automatically on a schedule

schedule_day.title: Backup day
schedule_day.description: Day of the week for weekly backups

enabled.title: Send notifications
enabled.description: Email needs TILECAST_SMTP_HOST on the server. Without it, notifications stay off and nothing fails.

from_address.title: From address
from_address.description: Address that notification email is sent from

minimum_severity.title: Minimum severity
minimum_severity.description: Conditions below this severity are recorded in Activity but are not sent

timezone.title: Notification timezone
timezone.description: Applies to the digest time and to quiet hours

quiet_hours_enabled.title: Quiet hours
quiet_hours_enabled.description: Holds notifications until quiet hours end. Critical conditions are always sent immediately.

stale_source_hours.title: Stale Data Source after
stale_source_hours.description: Hours without a successful refresh before a Data Source counts as stale. A weekly calendar tolerates far more than a weather feed.

expiring_media_days.title: Warn about expiring media
expiring_media_days.description: How far ahead the content health report lists media that is about to expire

enabled.title: Keep a snapshot history
enabled.description: Stores periodic screen images so you can see what a screen showed earlier. Snapshots are held in the database and are included in every backup.

max_per_screen.title: Snapshots to keep per screen
max_per_screen.description: The oldest are removed once a screen reaches this many, whatever the retention period says

approval_required.title: Legacy approval switch
approval_required.description: Retained for compatibility. New installations should use the content review policy.

review_policy.title: Content review policy
review_policy.description: Choose whether no content, Contributor work, or every publication requires approval.

allow_self_approval.title: Allow self-approval
allow_self_approval.description: Allow a reviewer to approve their own submission.

auto_publish_on_approval.title: Automatically publish approved submissions
auto_publish_on_approval.description: Publish immediately or schedule the requested time when a submission is approved.

mfa_required_scope.title: Require multi-factor authentication
mfa_required_scope.description: Accounts in scope must enroll an authenticator app or a passkey before they can use Tilecast Studio.

channel.title: Player update channel
channel.description: Stable is the hardened default. Beta releases still require an explicit deployment.

mode.title: Reliability mode
mode.description: Managed Kiosk becomes effective only when Android confirms device-policy capability.

launch_after_boot.title: Launch after boot
launch_after_boot.description: Android only. Linux players start at boot from a systemd user service, installed per screen from the screen's Reliability tab.

startup_grace_seconds.title: Startup grace
startup_grace_seconds.description: Android Power Assist only; Linux startup and process recovery are managed by systemd.

shutdown_prepare_seconds.title: Shutdown preparation
shutdown_prepare_seconds.description: Android Power Assist and status reporting only; Linux uses its systemd/display-control integration.

keep_screen_on.title: Keep screen awake during active hours
keep_screen_on.description: Android active-hours wake policy; Linux uses linux_kiosk.prevent_display_sleep for the host display-sleep blocker.

sleep_outside_active_hours.title: Request sleep outside active hours
sleep_outside_active_hours.description: Android Power Assist only; Linux shows its configured branded off-hours surface and does not request operating-system sleep.

outside_active_hours_display.title: Outside active hours
outside_active_hours_display.description: Choose what remains visible when the player is outside active hours and the display does not sleep.

outside_active_hours_text.title: Custom text
outside_active_hours_text.description: Centered text shown outside active hours. When empty, Tilecast uses the branding footer text.

fullscreen_enabled.title: Kiosk fullscreen
fullscreen_enabled.description: Keeps Tilecast in a frameless fullscreen kiosk window on Linux. TILECAST_WINDOWED=1 remains a local development override.

prevent_display_sleep.title: Prevent display sleep
prevent_display_sleep.description: Asks the Linux desktop session to keep the display awake while Tilecast Player is running.

control_assist_enabled.title: Accessibility Control Assist
control_assist_enabled.description: Hardened players request this behavior by default, but the Android service still requires deliberate local enablement.

mode.title: Notify me
mode.description: Immediate sends each condition as it happens. Digest collects them into one daily message.

address.title: Send to
address.description: Your email address. Notifications are not sent until this is set.

incidents.title: Screen problems
incidents.description: A screen stops reporting, playback fails, or a Player enters safe mode

content_health.title: Content problems
content_health.description: A Data Source is serving stale data, or a playlist has nothing available to play

general.title: General
general.description: Organization identity, regional formats, and support details.

branding.title: Branding
branding.description: Organization identity and the fallback appearance shown by players.

users.title: Users
users.description: Give each person an individual sign-in and assign only the permissions they need. Appearance and density preferences remain separate for every account.

security.title: Sign-in security
security.description: Decide who must use a second factor to sign in. Each person manages their own authenticator, passkeys, and recovery codes from My Account → Sign-in security.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Reusable buildings and campuses assigned to multiple screens, while room details stay on each player.

playback.title: Playback
playback.description: Default playback, storage, delivery, synchronization, and diagnostics.

media.title: Media
media.description: Upload limits, delivery defaults, and future media-processing behavior.

websites.title: Websites
websites.description: Safe defaults for website playback, reloads, cookies, and failures.

scheduling.title: Scheduling
scheduling.description: Schedule preparation, timing, and clock-warning defaults.

reliability.title: Reliability and kiosk
reliability.description: Shared recovery with platform-specific Android and Linux kiosk controls.

power.title: Active hours and power
power.description: Player operating hours and best-effort Android sleep and wake behavior.

accessibility.title: Accessibility control
accessibility.description: Optional foreground-return assistance with explicit safety pauses.

player-updates.title: Player updates
player-updates.description: Verified Tilecast Player releases and update deployments.

presentation-networks.title: Presentation Networks
presentation-networks.description: Temporarily connect supported Linux players to Wi-Fi for AirPlay and other local presentation features while keeping Ethernet as their primary Tilecast connection.

takeover.title: Takeovers and commands
takeover.description: Defaults for a Takeover started by hand and for player commands. Automatic weather alerts are the Emergency Alerts plugin.

retention.title: Data retention
retention.description: Bounded history and cleanup periods for operational records.

backups.title: Backup and restore
backups.description: Create, verify, download, schedule, and restore full installation backups.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Send alerts by email or webhook.

system.title: System
system.description: Safe diagnostics and deliberate maintenance actions.

content-review.title: Content review
content-review.description: Require approval before a playlist or Layout can be assigned to a screen. A Contributor authors content but cannot publish or assign it.

snapshots.title: Snapshot history
snapshots.description: Periodic Player screenshots with configurable retention.

integrations.title: Integration tokens
integrations.description: Scoped tokens for Manual Tables and fleet health.

dependency-graph.title: Dependency Graph
dependency-graph.description: Follow content and data through presentations, schedules, groups, and screens.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.description: Appearance and workflow preferences for your Studio account.

dependencies.customText: Choose Custom text to edit this setting.
dependencies.intervalReload: Choose interval reloads to set a refresh interval.
dependencies.activeHours: Enable active hours to edit this setting.
dependencies.managedKiosk: Select Managed Kiosk to edit this setting.
dependencies.accessibilityAssist: Enable Accessibility Control Assist to edit this setting.

packageList.label: Android package name
packageList.invalid: Enter an Android package name such as com.android.settings.

androidKiosk.title: Android Managed Kiosk
androidKiosk.description: Android-only controls that take effect when the device confirms compatible device-owner capability.

linuxKiosk.title: Linux kiosk
linuxKiosk.description: Linux window and desktop-session behavior. Starting at boot and restarting after process exit come from the player's systemd service, which is set up per screen from the screen's Reliability tab rather than here.

outside.title: Outside active hours
outside.description: Choose the fallback shown when the player is outside active hours and Android or the television remains awake.

retention.title: Scheduled backup retention
retention.description: Retention applies to scheduled backups. Manually created backups remain until an Owner deletes them.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.description: Email needs an SMTP relay configured on the server. Webhooks work without one.

timing.title: Timing
timing.description: A critical condition is always sent immediately, whatever these say.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: What Tilecast tells you about when you are not looking at Studio.

capture.title: Capture
capture.description: Snapshots are held in the database and are included in every backup. The caps below are what keep that bounded.

approval.title: Approval
approval.description: There is no submit step. Content is waiting for review whenever its current revision has no decision, so editing approved content sends it back automatically.

page.leaveSectionTitle: This section has unsaved changes. Keep them and open another Settings section?
page.conflict: These settings changed elsewhere. Reload the latest settings before saving.

reviewQueue.title: The review queue
reviewQueue.description: Content waiting for review is listed under Content review in the main navigation.

takeoverAlert.title: Automatic weather alerts moved to Plugins.
takeoverAlert.description: NWS monitoring, alert rules, and active emergencies are configured in the <alertsLink>Emergency Alerts</alertsLink> plugin. The defaults below apply to a Takeover started by hand and to player commands.

accessibilityAlert.title: Local setup is required on every player.
accessibilityAlert.description: Accessibility Control Assist must be enabled manually in Android Accessibility Settings. Enabling policy here does not grant Android permission.

powerAlert.description: Start and end times are identical. Choose a distinct range; an earlier end time is treated as overnight.

mfa.allRequired: Every account must enroll a second factor.
mfa.adminsRequired: Owners and Administrators must enroll a second factor.
mfa.consequence: Nobody is signed out. An account in scope that has not enrolled is asked to set up an authenticator app or a passkey at its next sign-in, and cannot use the rest of Studio until it does. An Owner or Administrator can clear a locked-out account’s factors from Settings → Users.
mfa.passkeysUnavailable: Passkeys are unavailable on this installation.
mfa.passkeysFallback: {{reason}} Authenticator apps and recovery codes work regardless.

preview.title: Player preview
preview.noContentMessage: This screen is ready for content.
preview.takeoverNote: Takeover keeps Tilecast’s fixed high-contrast treatment regardless of custom branding.

retention.title: Activity retention
retention.description: Cleanup runs in bounded background batches and respects deployment hard limits.
retention.loadError: Retention settings could not be loaded.
retention.saveError: Retention settings could not be saved.

validation.wholeDays: {{label}} must be a whole number of days.

branding.title: Organization images
branding.description: Upload images from this device. Tilecast stores the selected asset internally.

logo.title: Logo
logo.description: A wide organization logo for Tilecast Studio and supported player screens.

icon.title: Square icon
icon.description: A square mark for compact branding and icon-sized placements.

loginBackground.title: Login background
loginBackground.description: The full-screen image behind the Tilecast Studio sign-in panel.

branding.invalidType: Choose a PNG, JPEG, WebP, or SVG image.
branding.unavailable: The selected image is unavailable. Upload a replacement.

backups.ownerOnly: Only the Owner may manage backups.
backups.title: Installation backups
backups.description: Full backups include the database, media files, thumbnails, variants, and cached player updates.
backups.availableHint: Verify an archive before relying on it or starting a restore.
backups.emptyHint: No backups have been created yet.
backups.restoreBody: Tilecast will become temporarily unavailable and current database and media state will be replaced. A pre-restore backup will be created first.
backups.restoreBodyMismatch: Tilecast will become temporarily unavailable and current database and media state will be replaced. A pre-restore backup will be created first. WARNING: This backup belongs to a different installation. Enrolled players will need to be reset and paired again.
backups.deleteLastTitle: This is the last complete backup. Delete it anyway?
backups.deleteLastBody: You will have no known-good backup to restore.

integrations.ownerOnly: Only the Owner may manage integration tokens.
integrations.title: Integration tokens
integrations.description: Grant selected integrations without sharing a Studio password.
integrations.revokeBody: Anything using it stops working immediately, and a revoked token cannot be re-enabled.

write.title: Write Manual Table rows
write.description: Replace rows in selected Manual Table Data Sources.

read.title: Read fleet health
read.description: Read counts of screens by reporting state, unresolved incidents, and content problems, as JSON or Prometheus metrics.

integrations.nameHint: Name the system that will use it, so the delivery record and the audit log say who did what.
integrations.expiresHint: The token stops working at the end of this day. Leave it empty for a token that never expires, and revoke it when the system using it is retired.
integrations.limitHint: Select none to allow every Manual Table Data Source. Naming them is the safer default.
integrations.noSources: No Manual Table Data Sources exist yet.

locations.deleteConflict: This location still has screens assigned. Reassign or unassign them before deleting it.
locations.deleteFailed: The location could not be deleted.
locations.blockedTitle: {{name}} still has screens assigned and cannot be deleted.
locations.emptySearchHint: Try a different name or address.
locations.emptyHint: Add a building or campus to assign it to screens.

held.label: Held for canary
held.detail: Starts once every canary screen reports a successful update.

pending.label: Queued
pending.detail: The player has been told to fetch this release.

offline.label: Waiting to reconnect
offline.detail: The screen is unreachable and will start after it comes back.

downloaded.label: Downloaded
downloaded.detail: Waiting to verify the downloaded file.

verifying.label: Verifying
verifying.detail: Checking the downloaded file against its expected hash.

ready.label: Ready to install
ready.detail: Installation begins at the next moment this mode allows.

waiting_for_permission.label: Needs install permission
waiting_for_permission.detail: Allow this installation source on the TV so the player may install updates.

waiting_for_user.label: Needs approval on the TV
waiting_for_user.detail: Someone has to approve the installer on the TV itself. This is not a failure.

installing.label: Installing
installing.detail: The player is installing the release now.

reconnecting.label: Restarting
reconnecting.detail: The player restarted into the new version and is reconnecting.

already_current.label: Already current
already_current.detail: This screen was on the deployed version before the rollout began.

failed.label: Failed
failed.detail: The update stopped. Retry once the screen is reachable.

incompatible.label: Incompatible
incompatible.detail: This release cannot run on this screen's Android version.

unknown.label: Unknown
unknown.detail: This player reported a state Studio does not recognize.

headline.waiting_one: {{count}} screen is waiting on someone at the TV.
headline.waiting_other: {{count}} screens are waiting on someone at the TV.
headline.complete: Every screen is on this release.

updates.statusesLoadError: Screen statuses could not be loaded.
updates.pausedDetail: {{reason}} Remaining screens stay on their current version until the deployment is cancelled and re-created.
updates.emptyNone: This deployment reaches no screens you can see.
updates.cancelHint: Cancelling stops every screen that has not finished. Screens already updated stay on the new release.

panel.releasesHint: Upload a signed release directly or optionally synchronize from <repo>Gibsonmb71/tilecast</repo>.
panel.emptyReleases: No {{platform}} Player releases have been imported. Tilecast checks GitHub automatically; use Sync from GitHub to retry immediately.
panel.purgeDeleteTitle: Delete this release and free its cached file
panel.purgeFreeTitle: Free the cached file and keep the deployment history
panel.neverDeployed: It has never been deployed, so the release and its cached file are both removed.
panel.historyHint: Open a deployment to read the status of each screen it reaches. Waiting for approval means the TV still needs someone to accept the installer; it is not a failure.
panel.directHint: Tilecast cannot download it again. Deploying it later requires uploading the same signed release once more.
panel.purgeDeleted: Release deleted and its cached file freed.
panel.purgeFreed: Cached file freed. The release stays listed for its deployment history.
panel.setupHint: Configure <clientId>TILECAST_GITHUB_CLIENT_ID</clientId> with a device-flow-enabled GitHub OAuth App to enable sign-in.
panel.githubExpired: The GitHub authorization code expired. Start again for a new code.
panel.githubIncomplete: GitHub authorization could not be completed.
panel.verificationTitle: Player update verification is not configured.
panel.verificationHint: Set <key>TILECAST_UPDATE_MANIFEST_PUBLIC_KEY</key> on the Tilecast server to the public Ed25519 key used by the Player release workflow, then restart the server.
panel.syncErrorTitle: GitHub releases could not be synchronized.
panel.cacheErrorTitle: The release could not be cached.
panel.removeErrorTitle: The release could not be removed.
panel.deployHint: Choose a cached, verified release and target {{platform}} screens or Display Groups.
panel.noRelease: No release is ready to deploy
panel.canaryHint: Remaining targets wait until every canary reconnects. Use 0 to deploy to all targets at once.
panel.windowHint: Players install at or after this local time on each screen.
panel.noGroupMatch: No Display Group matches this search.
panel.androidNote: Android may require installation approval on each TV.
panel.linuxNote: Each Linux player restarts into the new version.
panel.offlineNoteOne: {{count}} selected screen is offline and will update after reconnecting.
panel.offlineNoteOther: {{count}} selected screens are offline and will update after reconnecting.
panel.historyLoadError: Deployment history could not be loaded.
panel.historyEmpty: No {{platform}} Player deployments have been created.
panel.readinessCacheDetail: Manifest verified. The artifact could not be cached.
panel.readinessDownloadingDetail: Verification finishes once the artifact is cached.
panel.readinessManifestDetail: Manifest signature verified. Download to deploy.
panel.readinessDeployableDetail: Download to make this release deployable.
panel.readinessVerifyingDetail: Artifact cached. Full verification has not finished.
panel.uploadHint: All three files are verified before the {{artifact}} enters Tilecast's private update cache.
panel.unexpectedFile: Unexpected file: {{name}}. Choose only the three signed release files.
panel.manifestTooBig: The update manifest must not exceed 128 KB.

panel.verifyingAndroid: Verifying signature, APK, and package metadata…

description.group: Override organization defaults for this Display Group.
description.screen: Override inherited playback and device behavior for this screen only.

policies.resetDescription: This clears every player-setting override for this target. This cannot be undone.
policies.saveErrorDescription: Reload the current policy if another administrator changed it.

storage.title: Storage and downloads
storage.description: Local cache limits and content delivery behavior.

websites.title: Websites
websites.description: Timeout, cookies, and local website data behavior.

reliability.title: Reliability and kiosk
reliability.description: Shared recovery plus platform-specific Android and Linux kiosk behavior.

power.title: Active hours and power
power.description: Operating hours, sleep requests, and black-screen fallback.

accessibility.title: Accessibility control
accessibility.description: Automatic return behavior and safe maintenance exclusions.

updates.title: Player updates
updates.description: Screen-specific update download and installation behavior.

policies.emptySearch: No matching settings in this section.
policies.emptySection: No screen-level settings are available in this section.

networks.saveError: The Presentation Network could not be saved.
networks.manageOnly: Only Owners and Administrators may manage Presentation Networks.
networks.title: Temporary Wi-Fi for local presentation
networks.description: Presentation Networks let supported Linux players join Wi-Fi only while an AirPlay session needs it. Ethernet remains the normal path for Tilecast traffic, downloads, and group video fan-out.
networks.credentialsUnavailable: Credentials are unavailable on this server.
networks.credentialsHint: Configure the Presentation Network encryption key before saving a network.
networks.listHint: Credentials are write-only. Editing a network without entering a new credential keeps the saved one.
networks.emptyHint: Add a staff, guest, or event Wi-Fi network when AirPlay senders cannot reach a player over Ethernet alone.
networks.deleteAssigned_one: {{name}} is assigned to {{count}} screen. Delete it and remove those assignments?
networks.deleteAssigned_other: {{name}} is assigned to {{count}} screens. Delete it and remove those assignments?
networks.deleteError: The Presentation Network could not be deleted.

fields.name: Display name
fields.nameHint: A name operators will recognize in Studio.
fields.ssidHint: The Wi-Fi name, not the Studio display name.
fields.secretHintNew: Write-only. It is encrypted before it is stored.
fields.secretHintSaved: A credential is saved. Leave this blank to keep it, or enter a new one to rotate it.
fields.secretHintNone: No credential is saved yet; enter one to enable provisioning.
fields.anonymousIdentityHint: Optional outer identity for the RADIUS server.
fields.caHint: Optional public CA certificate in PEM form. It is used to validate the RADIUS server.
fields.domainHint: Requires a CA certificate when set.

networks.assignedHint: Only the selected gateway joins this network during a group AirPlay session. Followers stay on Ethernet.
networks.noPlayers: No Linux players are available for assignment.

notifications.removeBody: Its signing secret cannot be recovered, so the receiver will need a new one.
notifications.configured: An SMTP relay is configured. Each account chooses what it receives under My Account → Preferences.
notifications.smtpSetup: Set <smtpHost>TILECAST_SMTP_HOST</smtpHost> (and <smtpPort>TILECAST_SMTP_PORT</smtpPort>, <smtpUsername>TILECAST_SMTP_USERNAME</smtpUsername>, <smtpPassword>TILECAST_SMTP_PASSWORD</smtpPassword> where the relay needs them), then restart the server.
notifications.testHint: A test goes to your own notification address and ignores quiet hours and subscriptions.
notifications.deliveriesEmptyHint: Nothing has been sent yet. Deliveries appear here when a condition is reported.

email.title: Email delivery
email.description: Tilecast sends through an SMTP relay configured on the server, not through an account in Studio.

deliveries.title: Recent deliveries
deliveries.description: What Tilecast tried to send, and what happened. A failure here means the message did not arrive.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.description: Tilecast posts signed JSON to a URL you control. Use a relay to reach a chat service; Tilecast has no per-service integrations.

notifications.secretNotice: Copy this signing secret now. Tilecast does not show it again, and there is no way to read it back.
notifications.verifyHint: Verify a request by computing <hmac>HMAC-SHA256(secret, timestamp + "." + body)</hmac> and comparing it with the <sigHeader>X-Tilecast-Signature</sigHeader> header. Reject a request whose <tsHeader>X-Tilecast-Timestamp</tsHeader> is not recent.

form.name: Name
form.nameHint: How this receiver is identified in the delivery log.
form.urlHint: HTTPS is required unless the receiver is on the local network.
form.categoriesHint: Select none to receive every category.

system.ownerOnly: Owner or Administrator access is required.
system.diagnosticsHint: Runtime status without secrets or sensitive paths.
system.diagnosticsError: System diagnostics could not be loaded. {{error}}

expired-upload-cleanup.label: Clean up expired uploads
expired-upload-cleanup.description: Removes expired temporary upload data according to retention policy.

completed-command-cleanup.label: Clean up command history
completed-command-cleanup.description: Removes completed commands older than the configured retention period.

retention-cleanup.label: Run retention cleanup
retention-cleanup.description: Applies configured retention policies to eligible operational records.

reconcile-config.label: Reconcile player configuration
reconcile-config.description: Asks connected players to retrieve their current effective configuration.

validate-media.label: Validate media storage
validate-media.description: Checks media storage and processing-tool availability without changing content.

importExport.ownerOnly: Only the Owner may import or export settings.
importExport.exportHint: Download organization settings and policy metadata without credentials, secrets, or media files.
importExport.importHint: Tilecast validates the document and shows a preview before anything changes.
importExport.policiesPresent: {{group}} group policies and {{screen}} screen policies are present.
